events.summary: Rippling launched a Bengaluru-based research and engineering group for AI infrastructure, evaluation, sandboxing, scaling, and latency optimization, while expanding its India workspace and hiring across AI and engineering roles.
events.headline: Rippling opened an AI Lab in Bengaluru

events.summary: Rippling launched plugins, skills, and automations that bring role-, team-, policy-, and permission-aware context to AI workflows.
events.headline: Rippling introduced new Rippling AI capabilities

events.summary: Rippling opened a 132,693-square-foot office at 330 West 34th Street to support more than 1,000 employees across go-to-market, engineering, product, design, operations, and corporate functions.
events.headline: Rippling opened a larger New York City office

events.summary: The release added multi-framework support, broader integrations, an audit portal, publishable trust centers, and embedded AI workflows for setup, remediation, and security questionnaires.
events.headline: Rippling reintroduced Automated Compliance with expanded AI features

events.summary: The new capability links license provisioning, eligibility, removal, and applicable reseller billing workflows to employee joins, changes, and departures.
events.headline: Rippling connected Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace licensing to employee lifecycle automation

events.summary: Neel Murthy was elevated from Vice President of Growth to Chief Marketing Officer.
events.headline: Neel Murthy became Rippling’s Chief Marketing Officer

events.summary: Skinner announced that she had joined Rippling as Vice President of Communications and Brand.
events.headline: Kristina Skinner joined Rippling as VP of Communications

events.summary: Rippling announced that the Reprompt AI team, founded by Lukas Martinelli and Rob Balian, joined the company to help move Rippling AI agents from prototype to production; terms were not disclosed.
events.headline: Reprompt AI joined Rippling
